query:
Last weekend I took my golden retriever puppy to the new dog park downtown, and he had the best time chasing a little corgi around the agility course for almost an hour. On the way home we stopped at that new bubble tea shop on Oak Street, and their taro milk tea with boba was so creamy I already want to go back again this weekend. I also just finished rearranging the succulent shelf in my living room yesterday, and I finally found the perfect spot for that little zebra haworthia I picked up at the plant sale last month.
